title: Together AI signs multi-year cloud contract with IREN

sources.quote: In July 2026, we entered into multi-year cloud services contracts with leading AI developers including Prometheus, Perplexity and Together AI, representing approximately $2.8 billion in aggregate total contract value.

explain: Together AI, itself an AI cloud, agreed to rent GPU capacity from IREN for several years. Its share of the $2.8 billion signed with three customers was not disclosed.
